findings.scenario: The fixture chmods d to 0500 before mkdir d/a d/b. On a non-root runner mkdir fails with Permission denied. Signal probes lack set -e, continue after the failed fixture setup and do not create those restricted entries either. Reverting only the helper chmod from u+rwx to the previously defective u+w still makes the complete hygiene gate exit 0.
